productFit.reason: Astroshop.eu lists the Celestron Heavy duty tripod for CPC 1100 as 'Product not available anymore'; Celestron's own page shows it as a US item. Mainly a US product now: one neutral sentence in its 'Who it's for' text.

localFacts.fact: KLM: hand baggage, including handles and wheels, max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm; by folded length the TC40 (50 cm) fits, the RT90C (59 cm) and the Tri-Pier (65 cm) do not.

Nationaal Park Lauwersmeer has been an International Dark Sky Association Dark Sky Park since October 2016; three spots are recommended (Lauwersnest, hemelplatforms Achter de Zwarten and Vlinderbalg). The Boschplaat on Terschelling was the first Dutch Dark Sky Park in 2015.

Telescoop.nl: a wooden deck or roof terrace works like a sound box, every step shows in the eyepiece; set the tripod on firm ground or grass, or use vibration dampers on a hard floor. After a night outside, dew sits on the legs: wipe them before collapsing them.
Dutch terms: statief, zuilverlenging (PE200), zuilstatief / tri-pier, strain wave / harmonische montering, contragewicht, poluitlijning, draagvermogen, 3/8"-schroefdraad, spikes.

localPainPoints.pain: Garden decks, balconies and roof terraces pass on every step as shake.
localPainPoints.fix: Put the tripod on firm ground or grass; on a deck, weight the spreader and use a stiffer steel tripod or the Tri-Pier.

quotes.text: Een houten vlonder of dakterras werkt als een klankkast: elke stap die je zet, zie je terug in het oculair.

localPainPoints.pain: Damp nights: dew on carbon and aluminium legs gets trapped in the leg locks.
localPainPoints.fix: Wipe the legs before collapsing, or let them dry extended indoors.

quotes.text: na een nacht buiten zit er vaak dauw op de poten

Deck/roof-terrace shake and dew care for Dutch back gardens.
